[[Master (Gree)|Master]] '''Totth'k''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] who controlled the [[Totth'k Lotos]], a rejuvenation pool located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malanose]] in the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]].
